Save a figure as TIFF (600 dpi, LZW) and PDF

Source: R/core-export.R
wgh_save_figure.Rd

Save a figure as TIFF (600 dpi, LZW) and PDF

Usage

wgh_save_figure(
  plot,
  file,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600,
  formats = c("tiff", "pdf")
)

Arguments

plot

A ggplot object.

file

File name without extension.

width, height

Size in inches.

dpi

Resolution of the TIFF.

formats

Formats to write.

Value

The written paths, invisibly.

Examples

p <- wgh_plot_spaghetti(growdat, "haz", n = 50)
wgh_save_figure(p, file.path(tempdir(), "spaghetti"), formats = "pdf", dpi = 300)
